key_insight: AWaRe-SAC is an uncertainty-aware reinforcement learning controller that proactively admits network slices on mmWave x-haul links by combining weather-driven capacity forecasts with a risk-aware Soft Actor-Critic policy, improving slice acceptance while limiting SLA violations under rain-induced fading.
problem_solved: How to make reliable slice admission decisions for mmWave fronthaul/midhaul/backhaul when link capacity is highly uncertain due to weather (rain) so stringent QoS/SLA targets are met without excessive conservative underutilization.
method: Model weather-induced capacity uncertainty (rain fading) and incorporate short-term forecasts/uncertainty envelopes into the decision process.
Design AWaRe-SAC — a Soft Actor-Critic variant with availability/risk-aware reward shaping or constraints that proactively decides slice admissions and (where relevant) resource allocation.
Train and evaluate in trace-driven simulations against baseline admission policies to demonstrate higher acceptance rates and fewer SLA violations under varying weather scenarios.
impact: Provides a practical RL approach for robust, safety-aware network control under input uncertainty—useful for ML practitioners building control agents where external stochastic processes (weather, demand) affect capacity and SLAs. Techniques (uncertainty incorporation, risk-aware RL) generalize to other constrained resource allocation problems.
visual_elements: Network diagram: x-haul slices over mmWave links with rain icons indicating weather impact and a control node making admission decisions.

paper_title: AWaRe-SAC: Proactive Slice Admission Control under Weather-Induced Capacity Uncertainty
paper_authors: Dror Jacoby, Yanzhi Li, Shuyue Yu, Nicola Di Cicco, Hagit Messer
